name: lever incline chest press (plate loaded)
description: A plate-loaded machine press on an incline that targets the upper chest and the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your upper chest.
Sit back and grip the handles with feet flat on the floor.
Press forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Squeeze the chest, then return slowly.
Keep your back against the pad and your shoulders down.
